# HCSO Staff and Partners recognized at Annual Crimestoppers Awards

On October 11th, 2022, members of the HCSO staff attended the Crime Stoppers Annual Awards breakfast, where our very own Cynthia Zoellner was a well-deserved award recipient, as well as our community partner Candice Tolbert with SuperSeeds!

We are so proud of these two leaders and the impact they’ve had on our department and the community at large.
